title: RBI Proposes $1 Lakh Crore Asset Threshold for Upper-Layer NBFCs (NBFC-UL)
summary: RBI proposes replacing top-10 asset ranking methodology with absolute ₹1 lakh crore asset size threshold for NBFC-UL classification.

blocks.content: RBI issued draft scale-based regulatory (SBR) norms proposing an **absolute ₹1 lakh crore asset threshold** for identifying Upper-Layer NBFCs, reviewed every 5 years.

items: **Govt NBFCs Included**: Removes carve-out excluding state-owned NBFCs, bringing **NABARD, Exim Bank, SIDBI, and NaBFID** under upper-layer supervision.
